descriptions.w3d_s20_push_pending_8016703c: Appears to append a value to a pending array at offset 1160, flushing first when 1024 entries are held.
descriptions.w3d_s20_drop_reference_8019ab0c: Appears to fetch an inner object through two virtual calls and decrement a byte count in the result.
descriptions.w3d_s20_matches_handle_8013f168: Appears to resolve a handle to an object and return whether its helper value equals the field at offset 112.
